prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1471; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the interests of our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full policy limits of liability coverage held by your insured for the vehicle involved in this collision, along with a copy of the declarations page for that policy. Please also identify any additional coverage that may apply, including excess or umbrella coverage.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle and telematics data, repair and appraisal records, witness information, and any electronic communications concerning the accident. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your compliance with these requests.
